title: An Educator-Guided LLM Pedagogical Agent for Scaffolded Feedback in Conceptual Database Design
abstract: arXiv:2610.00870v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We present an educator-guided LLM pedagogical agent for scaffolded feedback in conceptual database design. Integrated into an entity--relationship diagram (ERD) editor, the system grounds feedback in the student artifact, assignment requirements, educator-authored rubrics, and instructional resources. Its architecture separates hidden, artifact-grounded diagnosis from the workflow that controls the form and disclosure level of student-facing support.   We instantiate the architecture as a four-stage workflow progressing from concept checks and guided application to low-detail feedback and localized clarification. Each feedback request creates a stateful episode linked to versioned ERD states. In a deployment spanning three ERD environments and 383 feedback episodes, 71.1\% of observed target-level changes fully or partially incorporated the hidden diagnostic target, including many after Stages~1--2. translated_title: 教师引导的大语言模型教学智能体：面向概念数据库设计的支架式反馈
translated_abstract: 我们提出了一种由教师引导的大语言模型（LLM）教学智能体，用于概念数据库设计中的支架式反馈。该系统集成于实体-关系图（ERD）编辑器中，将反馈建立在学生作品、作业要求、教师编写的评分标准以及教学资源的基础之上。其架构将隐藏的、基于学生作品的诊断与控制面向学生支持的形式和披露程度的工作流相分离。我们将该架构实例化为一个四阶段工作流，从概念检查和引导式应用，逐步过渡到低细节反馈和局部澄清。每次反馈请求都会创建一个有状态的会话，并与版本化的ERD状态相关联。在覆盖三个ERD环境、共383次反馈会话的部署中，71.1%的观察到的目标层面变更完全或部分采纳了隐藏的诊断目标，其中包括许多发生在第1-2阶段之后的变更。定性分析表明，该阶段……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了一种由教师引导的LLM教学智能体，集成于ERD编辑器中，通过将隐藏的诊断与四阶段渐进式支架反馈工作流分离，为概念数据库设计教学提供支持，实证显示71.1%的学生修改采纳了系统的隐藏诊断目标。
en_tdlr: This paper presents an educator-guided LLM pedagogical agent integrated into an ERD editor that separates hidden artifact-grounded diagnosis from a four-stage scaffolded feedback workflow, with a real-world deployment across 383 feedback episodes showing that 71.1% of observed student changes incorporated the system's hidden diagnostic targets.
